verdict_text: **NO_CERTIFICATION_POSSIBLE** — by design (see the power ceiling). Direction read at row level: `inj_fresh1d` LOSES TO the incumbent pooled (Δ=-0.03523 ± 0.01785 clustered, CI95 [-0.07022, -0.00024], excludes zero) · `inj_freshest` TIES the incumbent pooled (Δ=-0.00076 ± 0.00726 clustered, CI95 [-0.01499, 0.01348], spans zero).

power_ceiling.reason: the mechanism can only act on capture-era rows, so the active-fold count is a DESIGN quantity: no effect of any size could clear these gates. The re-test trigger is calendar-bound — the capture era gains ~2 folds per season of NF-W0a forward capture, so PBO becomes evaluable at 4 folds (end of 2026).

stratifier_validation.confound: nfl.com publishes practice-only rows with a NULL report_status, so a pair crossing between a designation-publishing source and a practice-publishing one scores as a 'change' that is a SOURCE-FORMAT difference, not a designation change
stratifier_validation.note: a stratifier that does not separate the realized quantity may not be read (MH2.1) — this block runs BEFORE any lift is scored

carryover.note: structurally impossible in the legacy era (one nflverse report per player-week), so this is a capture-regime property, not a defect

capture_era.sign_convention: positive = the tighter rung BEATS the incumbent

stratified.note: the boundary is the VALIDATED stratifier cut, measured before any lift

preregistration.hypothesis: NF-W2d's 2025 attenuation is caused by consuming designations a fresher available capture has already superseded; restricting consumption to fresher captures should recover lift. The competing outcome (freshness costs volume) is registered as equally informative.
preregistration.deploy_held: best_alpha=0; changes no incumbent, no construction, no serving

multiplicity.note: a READING aid over the 8 reported comparisons — never a gate; at 2 active folds nothing is certifiable in either direction

era_stratum_shares.reading: the capture era is FRESHER on this cut (0.354 vs 0.076 of listed rows within 1 day), so a freshness DEFICIT cannot explain its smaller lift — the within-2025 gradient is real but does not transfer into an era explanation
era_stratum_shares.caveat: a legacy `date_modified` is the REPORT's own timestamp; a capture instant is when the page was photographed. Stamp age is not the same quantity across eras, so this comparison BOUNDS the freshness explanation rather than settling it.
